role_sought: Member of the National Assembly, Marne's 2nd constituency
detail: Elected UMP deputy for Marne's 2nd constituency, succeeding Jean-Claude Étienne. Her seat passed to her substitute (Arnaud Robinet) when she entered government in 2004.
Lost the Reims mayoral race to Adeline Hazan; subsequently sat as an opposition municipal councillor.

role_sought: Municipal councillor (Reims) and president of Grand Reims
detail: Re-elected to the Reims municipal council and re-elected president of the Grand Reims urban community in July 2020 (held until January 2024). Per HATVP she also served as deputy mayor of Reims (adjointe au maire) during 2020-2024.
